Definition: Korach, the name of two Edomites and three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Korah the son of Izhar takes men and rises against Moses and Aaron, and the earth opens her mouth and swallows them up, with all the men that appertained unto Korah. Yet the record adds one mercy: notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Korah's rebellion is the warning for every age: the earth opens for those who rise against God's chosen, but his sons did not die.
RelatedPeople: Korah, Son of Izhar; Moses; Aaron
